summary_en: Kohsai revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending January 2027, adding a special dividend of 5 yen per share to the ordinary dividend of 30 yen per share, bringing the total to 35 yen per share. The special dividend is being implemented to mitigate the impact of the company's decision to delist from the Tokyo Stock Exchange and maintain listing solely on the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Special Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On September 11, 2026, Kohsai Co., Ltd. announced a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2027 at an emergency board meeting. The company added a special dividend of 5 yen per share to the previously announced ordinary dividend of 30 yen per share, resulting in a total dividend of 35 yen per share.

The special dividend has been implemented in response to the company's decision to delist from the Tokyo Stock Exchange and maintain listing solely on the Nagoya Stock Exchange. The company determined that this special distribution would help mitigate the potential negative impact on shareholders resulting from the delisting from TSE. The year-end dividend payment is subject to approval at the 60th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled to be held in April 2027.
